revenue_basis_note: gross_revenue_total is the pre-discount line total (sum of fact_sales.gross_revenue); net_revenue_total is gross_revenue minus discount_amount (sum of fact_sales.net_revenue). Both exclude Cancelled orders. gross_margin_pct uses the net_revenue basis: (net_revenue_total - total_cost) / net_revenue_total. The analysis layer (src/analysis) has no post-discount revenue definition of its own -- this margin is defined here, on net_revenue.
